top_signals.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
top_signals.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that a large bank would be sanctioned next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NSE Downsizes India IPO, Showing Mounting Valuation Concern
top_signals.summary: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd., the world’s largest derivatives exchange by volume, has downsized its initial public offering, a sign of rising concern over the willingness of investors to buy into the deal at the valuation the firm had been seeking.
